summary: Review of evidence through May 6, 2025 shows no new conditions that would require tightening, loosening, or adding protections to the existing covenant package; all clauses remain appropriate as-is.

clauses.rationale: No new evidence alters Amazon Break Fee receipts or step-up/down triggers; the covenant already addresses those scenarios.
Going‑concern doubt noted in 2025‑03‑12 filing, but the covenant already forbids audit reports with a going‑concern exception, so no change needed.
Monthly financial deliverables and compliance certificates continue to be provided; no evidence of deficiency.
Amazon Break Fee of $94 million was paid and applied per the existing sweep; no new evidence requires amendment.
No new default or notice issues emerged; the notice‑of‑default clause remains adequate.

drift_reasons: All evidence reviewed is either already addressed by the current covenant package or does not substantively alter risk coverage, monitoring needs, or permitted behavior.
